suite.name: SCG Saturation Suite
suite.description: Offered-load sweeps (Phase D) as a 3x2 factorial: {loopback, gateway-routing, gateway-crypto} x {TCP, UDP}, all at 1 KB / 1 connection over a SHARED offered-load range so the curves are directly comparable. The three rows decompose the degradation: (routing - loopback) is the gateway's plaintext forwarding cost, (crypto - routing) is the crypto cost, and TCP-vs-UDP within a row isolates the transport at equal crypto. Each scenario first runs its headline fixed-load measurement, then sweeps offered load (sustained at each rate) to map the throughput curve and find the knee: saturation_gbps is the raw ceiling, max_lossfree_gbps is the highest goodput within the loss budget (defaults.loss_threshold_pct). Headline senders here blast unthrottled on purpose, so loss-prone paths (UDP/DTLS) are flagged 'overloaded' while the sweep reports the real sustainable rate. Per-point curves land in scenarios/<name>/saturation.csv.
suite.author: SESHAT

scenarios.name: sat_loopback_tcp_1KB
scenarios.description: Row 1 (kernel baseline), TCP: offered-load sweep over direct TCP loopback, no gateway.

scenarios.name: sat_loopback_udp_1KB
scenarios.description: Row 1 (kernel baseline), UDP: offered-load sweep over direct UDP loopback, no gateway.

scenarios.name: sat_gw_routing_tcp_1KB
scenarios.description: Row 2 (gateway plaintext forwarding), TCP: offered-load sweep through the SCG doing plaintext TCP routing. (routing - loopback) = gateway forwarding cost.

scenarios.name: sat_gw_routing_udp_1KB
scenarios.description: Row 2 (gateway plaintext forwarding), UDP: offered-load sweep through the SCG doing plaintext multi-client UDP routing. De-confounds the transport axis from crypto (its TCP peer is plaintext too).

scenarios.name: sat_gw_tls13_tcp_1KB
scenarios.description: Row 3 (gateway crypto), TCP: offered-load sweep through the SCG with TLS 1.3 (AES-GCM). (crypto - routing) = crypto cost on TCP.

scenarios.name: sat_gw_dtls12_udp_1KB
scenarios.description: Row 3 (gateway crypto), UDP: offered-load sweep through the SCG with DTLS 1.2 (AES-GCM). (crypto - routing) = crypto cost on UDP; the only path expected to shed load by packet loss.
